name: Wall of Roots
oracle_text:
Defender
Put a -0/-1 counter on this creature: Add {G}. Activate only once each turn.
blocked_sentences: Put a -0/-1 counter on this creature: Add {G}. Activate only once each turn.

needs.what: counters of the form +X/+Y or -X/-Y other than +1/+1 and -1/-1 (here a -0/-1 counter) that the characteristics pipeline reads as a P/T change in the counters step, so a put_counters cost of {"counter": "-0/-1"} lowers the creature's toughness by 1 per counter and a Wall of Roots with five of them dies to the toughness SBA
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The cost side exists (put_counters on an activated mana ability, with once_each_turn and add_mana), but counter kinds are free strings and characteristics.py only sums PLUS_ONE and MINUS_ONE into power/toughness, so a "-0/-1" counter is an inert tally and the wall would tap for {G} every turn without shrinking. Writing it as -1/-1 changes power too and interacts with +1/+1 annihilation; adding an unprinted static buff reading counters_on would be an extra ability lost to ability-removal effects, unlike a real counter
